name: Royal Heir Breaks My Heart In A Warzone
original_name: Royal Heir Breaks My Heart In A Warzone
overview: Royal Heir Breaks My Heart In A Warzone is a passionate war-time romance. Charlie, an ER doctor burdened by family obligations, reunites with her former lover Harry during a medical mission in a conflict zone. Unbeknownst to her, Harry is a prince who once left her due to a misunderstanding but never stopped loving her. Together, they face life-and-death challenges amid warfare, while Selina—a jealous medical officer—plots against Charlie, even colluding with terrorists. As the truth unfolds, Harry discovers that Charlie’s child is his own. In the end, he risks everything to rescue her and publicly declares their love, writing an unforgettable love story in the midst of war.
